results.title: Kailas FUGA Athlete William BOFFELLI wins at Schnalstal Alpine Trail
results.description: At the 19991 Schnalstal Alpine Trail presented by Kailas FUGA (SAT), elite trail runner Kailas FUGA athlete William BOFFELLI won the 52k/4,300m ULTRA.

results.title: The Cincinnati Reds Were Directionless at the Deadline
results.description: If there’s one thing fans like to talk about, it’s the trade deadline. Buyers and sellers have an opportunity to dream of a better future, whether that future is three months or three years away.

results.title: Wrist woes keep Alcaraz out of tourney
results.description: DEFENDING champion Carlos Alcaraz has withdrawn from the Cincinnati Open due to a lingering right wrist injury that has kept him out of action
